shots.prompt: One continuous realistic locked-off medium-wide product shot in the ordinary greenhouse of <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> defines the complete location and the single existing acrylic stand. <Picture 2> is only the exact original artwork printed on that same stand, not another object. Preserve the original open violet-pink irises, almond-shaped eyelid outlines, thin round gold glasses, eye positions, face proportions, pale bob haircut and original white/deep-violet/gold costume exactly. The entire print is a rigid inert flat illustration attached to the acrylic: its eye shapes, expression, glasses, face and body never change. Keep the whole original stand and clear base visible at the original size throughout; a stationary camera, no zoom or framing change. Only faint natural leaf shadows drift over the table and background leaves move gently. The stand and printed character do not move. Keep the same pots, foliage, weathered table, tray, spray bottle and shears. The greenhouse remains unoccupied. No extra person, hand, body part or human facial fragment, including background and reflections. No new object, second stand, cut, readable letters, speech, singing, humming or other voice.
